title: Secondary Education, B.S. — Biology Teaching Option (College of Education)
notes: Biology Teaching Option, University Park (of five content-area options: Biology, Chemistry, Earth and Space Science, English, Mathematics -- Biology chosen since it's the only one with a fully detailed 8-semester plan in the fetched source). Extended scied_catalog.json/spled_catalog.json/ci_catalog.json with SCIED 411W/412, SPLED 403B, CI 295/495C/495E. Real data artifact handled: CI 495C and CI 495E both cite 'LLED 412W/MTHED 412W/SCIED 412/SSED 412W' as corequisites/prereqs -- these are the content-methods courses for the English/Math/Science/Social-Studies teaching options respectively; only SCIED 412 (Science) applies to this Biology option, so the other three were treated as a shared bulletin template artifact across all Secondary Education options and not modeled, same judgment-call precedent as CI 495D's 'CI 495B' case in Elementary Education. Most SPLED/CI/SCIED courses also cite '2nd/4th/5th/7th-semester standing' prereqs the schema doesn't model directly, same limitation as ABSM/TURF's semester-standing courses. Re-verified 2026-08-26 against the live bulletin's isolated Biology-option table and CHEM 110's own course description page: CHEM 110's real, literal prereq is still MATH 22 (not MATH 140/141), confirming the MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 -> MATH 22 chain fix is still accurate; every other required course code is unchanged. Real gap fixed: 'Biochem Selection' had no real course list wired -- the department's real options (BMB 211/212, BMB 401/402, CHEM 202/203/210/212/213) are now wired via `match`. 'GEN ED (Literature)' (x2) is now wired via `match` to the same real college-wide Literature Selection course list used by Elementary and Early Childhood Education (same shared bulletin footnote/URL), on top of its existing GH gen_ed domain wiring. 'BIOL 300-400 Selection' (x2), 'BIOL Elective', 'Evolution/Elective', and 'GE Elective' remain generic placeholders -- the live bulletin explicitly states these categories are 'not enumerated in this section; consult program documentation or adviser,' so no real course list exists to wire per the 'never fabricate' rule.
